sloka: यदा पर्वणि काकुत्स्थ विश्रमार्थम् महागजः ।खेदात् चालयते शीर्षम् भूमि कम्पः तदा भवेत् ॥१-४०-१५॥
transliteration: yadā parvaṇi kākutstha viśramārtham mahāgajaḥ ।khedāt cālayate śīrṣam bhūmi kampaḥ tadā bhavet ॥1-40-15॥

translations.english: O Rama having circumabulated and honoured that mighty elephant, the protector of the quarter they reached the Rasatala by riving the earth.
